# RFR Real Estate — full summary

## Who RFR is

RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC ("RFR Real Estate", "RFR") is a licensed real estate brokerage and advisory firm based in Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), United Arab Emirates. It works only in Ras Al Khaimah: Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Services are sales, leasing, property management and investment advice, with one advisor throughout each client relationship.

Official website: www.rfrrealestate.com (https://www.rfrrealestate.com/) is the official website of RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC. The firm uses no other domain.

Disambiguation: this is not RFR Holding, the New York real estate company that also appears in searches for "RFR". The official website is www.rfrrealestate.com.

Founder: Richard Boswell, Founder · Real Estate Advisor — buying, selling and leasing, start to finish.
Other team: Drew Carlyle, Property & asset management — tenanting, renewals and reporting for owners abroad. Morgan James, Investment advisory — yields, payment plans and which launch to skip.

Contact: +971 58 501 5885 (phone and WhatsApp, https://wa.me/971585015885) · info@rfrrealestate.com · Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00, Saturday 10:00–16:00 (Gulf Standard Time).

Property Finder broker profile: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/broker/rfr-real-estate-v2-13173-13173

## Where RFR works

Ras Al Khaimah is one of the seven emirates of the UAE, north of Dubai and Sharjah.

- Al Marjan Island — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/al-marjan-island (full guide; comparison at https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas) : four coral-shaped man-made islands off the Al Hamra coast. Most of RAK's branded residences are being built here (Address, Nobu, JW Marriott, Nikki Beach, W), and the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort is due to open in 2027. Buy: from ~AED 920K (studio) to AED 1.7–3.5M for 1–2 bed branded homes. Rent: 1-bed ~AED 65–90K/yr, 2-bed ~AED 75–130K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 6–8%.
- Mina Al Arab — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/mina-al-arab (full guide) : lagoons, mangroves and the quiet side of the coast. Low-rise, family-led; villas, townhouses and lagoon-front apartments; RAK Academy about 10 minutes, RAK city centre 15 minutes, RAK Airport 30 minutes. Buy: apartments from ~AED 800K, villas AED 2.5–6M. Rent: 3-bed villa ~AED 85–140K/yr, 2-bed apartment ~AED 60–95K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 5.5–7%.
- Al Hamra Village — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/al-hamra-village (full guide) : golf, marina and the deepest rental market in RAK. The Emirate's original master community (18-hole championship golf course, marina and yacht club, Waldorf Astoria, mall), including Falcon Island; the closest established community to Al Marjan Island, about 12 minutes away; Dubai (DXB) about 50 minutes. Buy: apartments from ~AED 500K, townhouses and villas AED 1.5–5M. Rent: 1-bed ~AED 45–65K/yr, 3-bed villa ~AED 110–160K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 7–8.5%.
- Downtown RAK — the working city: corniche, hospitals, offices, Al Nakheel and Julphar. Buy: apartments from ~AED 400K. Rent: 2-bed ~AED 50–95K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 7–9%.

All figures are indicative, drawn from RFR's own listings and public launch data.

Freehold: Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab and Al Hamra Village are designated freehold areas. In Downtown RAK, freehold is limited to designated projects such as Julphar Towers and RAK Central.

## Best areas to live in Ras Al Khaimah (as answered on /areas#best-areas)

- Living in Al Marjan Island: a group of four man-made, coral-shaped islands off the Al Hamra coast, where most of Ras Al Khaimah's branded residences are being built and where the Wynn resort is due to open in 2027. Suits overseas investors, holiday-let owners, resort professionals and second-home buyers from Dubai.
- Living in Mina Al Arab: a low-rise waterfront community of villas, townhouses and lagoon-front apartments, built around lagoons and protected mangroves and anchored by the Anantara and InterContinental resorts. Suits families relocating to RAK, long-term residents and buyers who want water without the resort crowds; RAK Academy is about 10 minutes away.
- Living in Al Hamra Village: the Emirate's original master community, with an 18-hole championship golf course, a marina and yacht club, a mall and the deepest rental market in RAK. Suits families, golfers and investors who want tenants in place from day one; the closest established community to Al Marjan Island.
- Living in Downtown RAK: the working city around Al Nakheel, Julphar and the corniche, with the shortest commutes to RAKEZ, the hospitals and government. Suits professionals, RAKEZ business owners and medical and education staff; the lowest entry prices of the four.

## Buying property in Ras Al Khaimah as a foreigner (as published on /can-foreigners-buy-property-in-ras-al-khaimah and /buy-sell-lease#buying-as-a-foreigner)

Full guide: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/can-foreigners-buy-property-in-ras-al-khaimah

Short answer: Yes. Foreigners can buy freehold property in Ras Al Khaimah's designated freehold areas: Al Hamra Village, Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island, RAK Central, Julphar Towers, Al Maareedh (plots) and the upcoming Beach District. You own it outright, on a title deed. UAE and GCC nationals can buy anywhere in the Emirate. The buyer pays a 2% registration fee. Foreign buyers can also buy off-plan on Al Marjan Island, which is freehold.

Freehold areas and fees as published by Ras Al Khaimah Municipality (Lands & Properties Sector), checked 14 November 2026. Rules and fees can change.

- Who can buy: UAE and GCC nationals anywhere in the Emirate. Other foreign nationals, whether UAE residents or overseas, can buy freehold in the designated freehold areas: Al Hamra Village, Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island, RAK Central, Julphar Towers, Al Maareedh (plots) and the upcoming Beach District. Confirm the exact plot or building is inside a freehold area before paying a deposit.
- Freehold means full ownership in your own name, recorded on a title deed.
- Government fees: registration 2% of market value paid by the buyer (the seller pays a further 2%); AED 200 plan issuance; AED 200 title deed issuance; mortgage registration 0.1% of the loan, where there is a mortgage. Agency commission (RFR: 2% + VAT) and developer charges are separate. Worked example: AED 1,000,000 apartment, no mortgage = AED 20,400 in buyer's government fees.
- Steps: 1) set budget and goal (live, let or Golden Visa), including the 2% fee; 2) shortlist an area; 3) view in person or on video; 4) reserve and sign (MOU for resale, developer SPA for off-plan); 5) developer NOC; 6) transfer and register at RAK Municipality, receive the title deed; 7) take handover or let it out.
- Resale documents: Emirates ID or passport; developer NOC (freehold areas); the seller's original title deed; power of attorney if an agent acts for either party.
- Buying from abroad: not necessarily a need to be in the UAE; RFR runs video viewings and a power of attorney can be used at the transfer.
- Tax: no income tax or capital gains tax on property in the UAE.
- Golden Visa: property worth AED 2M or more can qualify, subject to federal ICP rules at the time you apply. Official pages differ on the term: ICP and RAKEZ describe 10 years, the u.ae portal lists 5 years for real estate investments. RAKEZ states the applicant must be inside the UAE when submitting. RFR does not issue visas or give immigration advice. Full guide: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/golden-visa-property-ras-al-khaimah

## Golden Visa by buying property in Ras Al Khaimah (as published on /golden-visa-property-ras-al-khaimah)

Full guide: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/golden-visa-property-ras-al-khaimah

Short answer: Yes. The UAE Golden Visa (ICP calls it the Golden Residency) is federal, so it applies to property in Ras Al Khaimah too. You need to own one or more UAE properties worth a total of at least AED 2,000,000, registered in your name (a loan from an approved local bank is allowed), or off-plan units totalling at least AED 2,000,000 bought from an approved local developer, plus health insurance for you and your family. RFR helps you find qualifying property; ICP issues the visa.

Rules as published by ICP (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security) and the UAE Government portal u.ae, checked 24 November 2026. General information, not legal or immigration advice; ICP decides every application and rules can change.

- Property value (ICP Golden Residency Guide): the investor must own one or more properties in the UAE with a total value of at least AED 2,000,000, with full ownership registered in the investor's name.
- Mortgage (ICP guide): the property may be financed through a loan, provided the financing is obtained from an approved local bank.
- Off-plan (ICP guide): one or more off-plan property units with a total value of at least AED 2,000,000, provided the purchase is made from an approved local real estate company authorised by the competent local authority.
- Health insurance (ICP guide): the investor and their family members must have comprehensive and valid health insurance coverage throughout the validity period of the residency.
- Term: the ICP Golden Residency Guide (last updated 10 September 2026) lists 10 years for investors in the UAE's real estate sector; the u.ae Golden visa page (updated 28 July 2026) lists 5 years for real estate investments. The permit ICP issues states its own validity; confirm the term with ICP.
- Benefits listed by ICP: long-term residency without a sponsor; residence permits for spouse and children, regardless of the children's age, and for parents; freedom to live, work, study and invest; ability to sponsor domestic workers; applicants outside the UAE are granted a six-month, multiple-entry entry visa, renewable for a further six months, to complete the procedures; if the holder dies, sponsored family members may stay for the validity of their residence permits.
- Steps: 1) choose one or more properties in a Ras Al Khaimah freehold area with a total value of at least AED 2,000,000; 2) buy and register the property in your name with Ras Al Khaimah Municipality, Lands & Properties Sector; 3) get a letter from the land registration department confirming you own property with a total value of at least AED 2,000,000; 4) arrange health insurance for you and your family; 5) apply to ICP through the ICP smart app or the ICP smart services website.
- Documents and conditions ICP lists for its service "Issue entry permit for residence of a real estate investor": passport (valid at least 6 months), personal photo, the land registration letter; health insurance valid inside the UAE; the property must be fully owned by the investor.
- Fees ICP lists for that entry-permit service only: AED 100 application, AED 100 issue, AED 100 smart services. Fees for the residence itself and the Emirates ID are set by ICP at the time you apply.
- RFR's role: RFR helps you find and buy qualifying property in Ras Al Khaimah. RFR does not issue visas or give legal or immigration advice.
- Sources: https://icp.gov.ae/en/services/uae-golden-residency/ ; https://icp.gov.ae/services-details/?serviceid=68e34eea5ae59b00117383d5 ; https://u.ae/en/information-and-services/visa-and-emirates-id/residence-visas/golden-visa

## Is Ras Al Khaimah a good place to buy property? (as published on /market#good-place-to-buy)

It can be, for the right buyer. In its favour: freehold for foreigners in designated areas; no income or capital gains tax on UAE property; a Golden Visa route from AED 2M; Wynn Al Marjan Island scheduled to open in 2027; off-plan plans from 50/50 to 80/20. To weigh: freehold only in those areas; the 2% registration fee; official pages differ on a 5- or 10-year visa; nobody knows what prices or rents will do once Wynn opens; growth slowed during 2026; more than 34,000 homes expected 2026–2030.

Published 2026 data (not forecasts; sources measure different things): CBRE H1 2026 (published 21 September 2026) reported Al Marjan Island apartment values up 23.1% year on year, with pricing and absorption moderating after the end of February 2026. ValuStrat Q2 2026 (reported 4 August 2026) put the overall Ras Al Khaimah index up 5.4% on the year and down 0.5% on the quarter, the first quarterly decline in more than two years. CBRE expects more than 34,000 residential units between 2026 and 2030, around 10,000 of them branded residences.

Before you buy: confirm the rules; check the freehold status of the exact unit; check the developer, plan and plot; get the payment schedule in writing; ask for the service charge; look for evidence of rental demand; budget the total cost.
